tasks.label: Validate
tasks.detail: Runs the full CI-equivalent local gate: formatting, compile checks, quality checks, dependency audit, and tests.

tasks.label: Quality
tasks.detail: Runs static quality checks: ESLint, Stylelint, HTML validation, and unused dependency/code detection.

tasks.label: Compile Check
tasks.detail: Checks that JavaScript parses and Sass compiles without producing a production build.

tasks.label: Format Check
tasks.detail: Checks Prettier formatting across the repository without changing files.

tasks.label: Format
tasks.detail: Applies Prettier formatting across the repository.

tasks.label: Test
tasks.detail: Runs the project test suite once tests are configured.

tasks.label: Build
tasks.detail: Creates the production Vite build artifact.

tasks.label: Dev Server
tasks.detail: Starts the local Vite development server.
